Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run in your browser and start right away, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site accepts only family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, the light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If you can't get a game to start, write to us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. We will look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. Others are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 20 were sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?

Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you. The page /publish-html5-game/ also compares the portals a developer can publish on.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I put a game on my own website?
You can for the site's own games: each one has an "Embed this game" box on its page with ready-made code. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they have no embed code.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
